title: galium affrenum
intro: Galium affrenum, commonly known as Bitter Galium, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help alleviate symptoms of fever, headache, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Galium affrenum include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and act as a diuretic, making it a potential natural remedy for conditions such as kidney stones and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Galium affrenum include flavonoids, iridoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
